jobs.title: Managing Director II Trade Finance
jobs.description:
Overview

This is a hybrid role with the expectation that time working will regularly take place inside and outside of a company office.

The Head of Trade Finance leads the bank’s global trade finance business and strategy, positioning First Citizens as a market leader in trade finance solutions. This role is responsible for the end-to-end trade finance business across all First Citizens clientele, including sales strategy, revenue growth, product strategy and delivery, risk management and controls, team leadership, and close partnership with banking and credit teams. The role sits within the Global Banking & Markets Solutions organization and requires a business leader who can run a P&L, build and develop a high-performing specialist team, shape strategy, and engage with senior clients and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership and Vision - Develop and execute the long-term strategy for the trade finance business. Drive innovation in trade finance products and services. Align trade finance strategies with overall bank objectives and market opportunities.

Business Growth and Market Expansion - Identify and pursue opportunities for expanding the trade finance business globally. Lead strategic partnerships and potential acquisitions in the trade finance space. Drive revenue growth and profitability of the trade finance product line.

Team Leadership and Organizational Development - Lead and mentor senior executives across the trade finance division. Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and client-centric service. Develop and implement strategies for attracting and retaining top talent.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement - Serve as the senior relationship manager for strategic global clients and partners. Represent SVB as a thought leader at high-profile industry events and forums. Engage with regulators and industry bodies on trade finance matters.

Risk and Governance Oversight - Establish risk management frameworks for trade finance. Ensure robust governance structures and compliance with international regulations. Lead high-level discussions with regulators and policymakers to shape industry standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree and 10 years of experience in banking and/or trade finance experience, with leadership responsibility in trade finance, structured trade, transaction banking, or a closely related business OR High School Diploma or GED and 14 years of experience in banking and/or trade finance experience, with leadership responsibility in trade finance, structured trade, transaction banking, or a closely related business.

Preferred Experience

15+ years of banking and/or trade finance experience, with leadership responsibility in trade finance, structured trade, transaction banking, or a closely related business.

Core Competencies

Business acumen / knowledge - Advanced
Credit structuring capability and knowledge of credit processes - Advanced
Communication and Presentation skills - Advanced
Decision making and Prioritising - Advanced
Effective challenge - Advanced
Influence - Advanced
Innovation - Advanced
Organizational awareness - Advanced
Vision - Establish and articulate - Advanced
Partnerships and collaboration - Advanced
Sales management and leadership - Advanced

Position Specific Skills

Leadership - Advanced
Global trade finance expertise - Advanced
Strategic visioning and execution - Advanced
Executive-level stakeholder management - Advanced
Business transformation and innovation - Advanced
Data-led decision making – Advanced
Global risk management - Advanced
Organizational leadership - Advanced
Financial acumen - Advanced
Regulatory and policy expertise - Advanced
Cross-cultural leadership - Advanced
Risk Identification - Advanced
Risk Mitigation - Advanced
Business and technology integration - Advanced
Mergers and acquisitions - Advanced

Additional Information

If hired in NY, CA or MA, the base pay for this position is generally between $263,160.00 and $356,040.00. If hired in NC, the base pay for this position is generally between $219,300.00 and $296,700.00. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment.

Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.

jobs.title: Program Director - Owner's Rep
jobs.description:
Skanska is searching for a dynamic Program Director. This is a great opportunity to start a career with a company that builds things that matter and values its team. We are proud to share our culture of diversity and inclusion.

Our work makes a clear contribution to society and the environment around us. We build in many different verticals. Whether we are building schools to provide inspiring spaces for learning, roads to connect communities or hospitals to care for patients, it all contributes to our purpose – we build for a better society.

Skanska's values —Be Better Together, Act Ethically and Transparently, Commit to Customer and Care for Life—are deeply engrained in how we work, which is why our values support and drive our D&I efforts.

Skanska Integrated Solutions (SIS)

Skanska provides construction project management consulting services through our in-house group known as Skanska Integrated Solutions (SIS). With a 30-year track record of success, SIS functions as an “extension of staff” and is a trusted advisor to its clients. Skanska’s construction and project delivery expertise translates directly into maximum savings and quality.

The Program Director will manage a capital construction program(s) to lead project and construction management teams in the development and delivery of multiple projects concurrently. The Program Director reports to Skanska’s Regional Director on public and/or private assignments to manage a portfolio of projects. Acting in the role of Owner’s Agent, the Program Director is responsible for project management and construction management teams in all project phases, including studies, programming and planning, preconstruction services, design, procurements, construction, and closeout. The Program Director is the team leader, responsible for project initiation and operations through the completion of construction. The Program Director is responsible for staff mentoring, project management processes and methods, stakeholder communications, coordination, and conflict resolution, to ensure project goals are met. The position requires business management acumen, strong leadership skills, presentation skills, organizational and team building skills, as well as a working knowledge of project controls, quality assurance, risk management, budget management, time management, and client servicing skills. The Program Director must be a strategic communicator, adaptable, a collaborative team player, with problem-solving and risk management skills, plus a solid understanding of the tasks and skills provided by the team members whom they supervise.

Program Director Required Qualifications:

10+ years experience as a Senior Project Manager, Program Manager or Director role leading commercial and/or public sector building construction projects in California.
10+ years experience collaborating with owners, architects, engineers and contractors, and engendering a partnership culture to maintain positive stakeholder working relationships.
10+ years experience managing and enforcing the terms and conditions of project contracts.
10+ years experience working with the authorities having jurisdiction and utility providers.
10+ years experience embedded on jobsites providing in construction quality assurance.
10+ years experience in managing the schedule review and commenting process.
10+ years experience identifying, mitigating, and managing project risks.
10+ years working with a preconstruction team to manage costs (e.g., project logistics, planning, scope review, budgeting, estimating, value engineering and cost benefit analysis).
10+ years experience managing the design process and relationships between design and construction to ensure the designer delivers quality, budget conscious, and complete documents on schedule.
10+ years experience reviewing design drawings, technical specifications, requests for information, construction submittals, product cut sheets, and providing comments.
10+ years experience drafting a Project Work Plan and implementating delivery strategies.
10+ years experience in strategically planning, tailoring and implementing various project delivery methods (e.g. CM at Risk with GMP, Design Bid Build Lump Sum Hard Bid, Design Build, Progressive Design Build, Integrated Project Delivery, etc.).
10+ years experience targeting and pursuing additional business opportunities with existing clients, and develop new business opportunities.
Bachelors or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in Construction Management, Architecture, or Engineering, and 10+ years of full-time industry experience.

Our
Investment
in you:

That’s why we provide an array of options (including medical, dental, and vision insurance plans), expert guidance, and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially, and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. jobs.title: Head of Partner Engagement & Strategy, Managing Director
jobs.description:
Citi’s mission is to serve as a trusted partner to its clients and communities by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. Citi is a trusted brand with over 200 years of helping to lead the way in the continuously evolving financial services sector. Citi has made it a priority to foster a culture where the best people want to work and where opportunities to develop are widely available to all. We are guided by our leadership standards, a common set of skills and expected behaviours that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

U.S. Consumer Cards offers branded cards, retail private label cards, payment, credit and unsecured lending solutions to consumers and small businesses, with over 100 million customer accounts in North America. With a wide range of proprietary, co-brand and private label cards with leading brands and innovative lending solutions, we have a full spectrum of client-centric payment and lending products and features.

We are focused on evolving with today’s consumer and continue to launch new and innovative card products, evolve our value propositions and reward offerings, extend to new partnerships and provide new digital capabilities to make purchases faster, convenient, and more rewarding.

USCC already has a range of partnerships across a broad spectrum delivering commercial and strategic customer focused outcomes – typically, either to improve product distribution or enhance product capabilities, often with a view towards future industry developments to seize relevant opportunities or protect against emergent risks. These partnerships include over 35 mainstream retailers and e-tailers, hospitality and travel partners; beyond this, Citi has partnerships with large tech industry players, payment providers of various stripes, as well as with specific capability providers; sometimes, these are also in the context of industry coalitions, where Citi often plays a leading role.

To continue this mission, we are seeking to hire the Head of Partner Engagement & Strategy for the Partnership Cards and Development organization (PCD). This critical leadership role will work closely with the Head of PCD and the senior leadership team across USCC to set the vision and strategy for the partnership business, renew existing partnerships and optimize portfolios in alignment with the USCC strategy. This role will also drive the work with key stakeholders to enhance capabilities across cobrand and private label products and working closely with portfolio general managers to prioritize and drive a consistent approach on partner engagement.

This role will lead a team of professionals with direct responsibility to support new partnerships programs to deliver against USCC’s mission and goals, across all the above partner sets. The role will require an in-depth understanding of consumer banking products and services industry and competitive product and service offerings, juxtaposed against Citi’s strengths and capability gaps. A good understanding of the payments industry and digital commerce is vital, as is a grasp of mid-large sized private label and co-brand partnership programs.

The successful candidate for this high impact role requires expertise in negotiation, relationship management, strategic thinking, people leadership, strong financial acumen and an entrepreneurial mindset. Approaching this space with a One-Citi mindset is key. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity beyond USCC. The role will require regular engagement with senior C-suite leaders within and throughout Citi, so communications skills and conviction on deal stance are important attributes.

Responsibilities Include:

Partner with the USCC businesses to identify and implement strategic and tactical initiatives that provide Citi with a sustainable competitive advantage in the marketplace- include supporting potential partnerships, defining partnership constructs and negotiating and executing agreements.
Support or lead transactions from beginning to closing (client sourcing, pitching, M&A process, valuation analyses, due diligence, negotiations, closing)
Evaluate potential transactions and business cases from a strategic, operational, and financial perspective. Lead or assist in client meetings and pitches, providing strategic advice and proposals.
Establish the strategy and direct resources to develop, negotiate and secure manage existing partner contract negotiations.
Integrates Citigroup product offerings as part of a robust financial solutions package as part of the new business and merger/acquisitions activity.
Assist in evaluating the internal and external business environment to develop a long-term overall vision and strategy for the organization.
Oversee key analysis and support for negotiations while working closely with internal and external partners to structure and execute transactions.
Manage internal and external processes for sourcing, evaluating, winning, and closing new partner programs and retention of existing relationships.
Analyze prospects by gathering information about growth, competitors, and market share possibilities.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, keeping as priority the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citi’s clients and assets.
Drives compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervising the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

The key characteristics of the ideal candidate for the position are:

Strategic thinking, financial acumen, and an entrepreneurial mindset.
Excellent stakeholder management skills to ensure alignment and buy-in across the organization.
Superior negotiating proficiency
Continuously challenging the status quo
Strong leadership who leads a high performing organization, focuses on building talent and organizational depth.
Executive communication skills. Ability to synthesize complex and multiple source data into fact based and nuanced solutions.
Ability to build highly credible, influential, and trusting relationships across the firm and with key external partners.
Influential and high track record of followership with demonstrated experience gaining consensus and alignment in a highly matrixed environment.
Ability to set priorities and ‘triage’ in a fast paced, highly matrix, dynamic environment.
Self-motivated, highly adaptive, and able to work well in high stress.
High ethical standards and mature risk tolerance who structures deal with balancing risk and reward.

Requirements:

15+ years of management experience with expertise in financial services
Analytical and conceptual thinker with ability to operate in “white space.”
Demonstrated success in managing internal and external partnerships and ability to negotiate complex structures.
Successful track record of executing deals.
Prior P&L management, strong financial acumen, and analytical skills
Ability to lead cross-functional teams through a clear and consistent line of sight regarding critical work activities.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
New York Forwarding Services, Inc. is a global transportation company based in Berkeley Heights, New Jersey, specializing in inland, ocean, and air freight for commercial, government, and military customers. Operating as a Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) and Freight Forwarder, the company provides logistics solutions across major modes of transportation. It maintains offices and warehouses in the NYC metropolitan area, Richmond/Norfolk, VA, and Wilmington, NC to ensure efficient access to key ports, airports, rail hubs, and roadways along the U.S. East Coast. New York Forwarding Services, Inc. also has regional offices and agents in Egypt and across the Middle East and East Asia, supporting a strong global network. Team members join a business focused on reliability, service quality, and international reach.
Role Description
The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is a full-time, on-site role based in Jersey City, NJ, responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations across all transportation and logistics functions. This role leads operational planning and execution, ensuring processes are efficient, compliant, and aligned with company strategy. The COO will manage departmental leaders, set performance goals, and monitor key operational metrics for domestic and international freight activities. Daily responsibilities include optimizing resource allocation, coordinating with finance on budgets and cost controls, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The COO will collaborate closely with the executive team on business planning, risk management, and long-term growth, while fostering a high-performance, safety-focused, and inclusive workplace culture.
Qualifications

Strong operations management skills, including experience overseeing logistics, transportation, or supply chain functions.
Demonstrated expertise in business planning and strategic execution, with the ability to align operations with organizational goals.
Advanced analytical skills, including the ability to interpret data, assess performance, and make data-informed decisions.
Solid knowledge of finance and budgeting, including cost control, forecasting, and resource allocation.
Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional teams and developing people in a diverse, inclusive environment.
Experience in freight forwarding, NVOCC operations, or related global logistics fields is highly beneficial.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including working with international partners and clients.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain Management, or a related field; advanced degree (e.g., MBA) is a plus.
Ability to work on-site in Jersey City, NJ and travel occasionally to domestic and international locations as business needs require.

jobs.title: Community Development Director
jobs.description:
**Community Development Director**

**HIRING RANGE: $190,000 - $220,000 annually**

For complete details about the position, click [here](http://trimviewint:8090/?=FORM/1224){rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"} to view the Recruitment Brochure for the Community Development Director of the City of Grand Junction.

To watch our Recruitment video and hear from our team click [here.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w4pMPqgt-sI){rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"}

About The Position

The Community Development Director leads the City of Grand Junction's Community Development Department and serves on the Executive Leadership Team, reporting to the Deputy City Manager. The Director oversees planning and development services, historic preservation, and housing initiatives while helping guide the City's long-term growth and redevelopment.

The ideal candidate is a strong, approachable leader who can clearly communicate complex issues to City Council, residents, developers, and community partners. They will value responsive customer service, consistent application of City codes, and transparent decision-making.

This position requires sound judgment, diplomacy, and the ability to navigate competing priorities in a highly visible environment. The successful candidate will build strong relationships, manage department priorities and resources, and help advance the City's community development goals.

About The Community Development Department

The Community Development Department leads the City's community planning, development services, zoning, historic preservation, and housing functions, and works closely with economic development partners and community organizations to support the City's growth and reinvestment priorities. The department manages current and long-range planning, plan and permit review, annexation, and maintains the City's zoning and development code, and the City's Comprehensive Plan. As a HUD entitlement community, the City receives a direct federal Community Development Block Grant allocation, which the department administers alongside other state and local housing funding.

The department collaborates closely with other City departments, regional and state partners, and community and economic development organizations to advance shared priorities.

What You'll Do

Provide strategic and operational leadership for the City's Community Development Department, including planning and development services, historic preservation, housing, and related community development initiatives.
Lead department priorities, budget development, grant administration, complex development and funding agreements, and continuous improvement of development review and permitting services.
Build and maintain effective relationships with City Council, Planning Commission, community members, developers, economic development partners, and other internal and external stakeholders.
Identify and respond to complex, sensitive, and highly visible community development issues while balancing regulatory requirements, customer service, organizational priorities, and community interests.
Partner with the City Manager, economic development organizations, and other community partners to advance major redevelopment and economic development initiatives throughout the community.
Lead, develop, and support a high-performing team through clear expectations, accountability, collaboration, and professional development.

To view the full job description, click [HERE ](https://trimview.gjcity.org/?=JOBDESC/402){rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"}

What We're Looking For

Seven (7) years of increasingly responsible community development experience including three (3) years of management and administrative responsibility.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in urban planning, public administration or related ield. Master's degree preferred.
American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) certification.
Possession of, or ability to obtain, a valid Colorado Driver's license
Possession of, or ability to obtain, the City of Grand Junction Leadership Track certification within two (2) years of appointment.

Other combinations of experience and education that meet the minimum requirements may be substituted.

Notice To Applicants

jobs.title: Program Director, Aviation (Cogen Facility)
jobs.description:
TYLin
is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

Job Summary

Some opportunities define a career. This is one of them.

TYLin is seeking an exceptional Program Director, Aviation (MEP) to join our Aviation team and play a pivotal leadership role in the delivery of some of the largest and most complex airport capital infrastructure programs currently underway in the US.

Working as part of TYLin's Aviation team, you will serve as one of the senior leaders responsible for delivering a multi-billion-dollar terminal redevelopment program that will modernize critical airport infrastructure for generations to come.

This role is ideal for an experienced infrastructure leader who thrives on solving complex engineering challenges, leading multidisciplinary teams, and delivering major Design-Build or alternative delivery programs in demanding operational environments.

If you're motivated by projects that leave a lasting legacy and want to be at the forefront of transforming one of the busiest aviation hubs in the world - we'd like to hear from you.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

The Opportunity

As Program Director, you will provide executive leadership for the planning, coordination, and delivery of major Mechanical, Electrical and Plant Infrastructure initiatives supporting terminal redevelopment.

A cornerstone of this program is the decommissioning of existing central utility infrastructure and the delivery of new state-of-the-art heating, refrigeration and mechanical plant systems that will support the airport's future operations.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to the client, oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams, coordinate numerous consultant and contractor partners, and ensure successful execution across every phase of the program.

This is a highly visible leadership position with significant responsibility, requiring regular collaboration with executive stakeholders, owners, designers, contractors and construction teams.

Responsibilities

Lead delivery of a major aviation infrastructure program on behalf of the client.
Provide strategic leadership across complex mechanical, electrical and utility infrastructure projects supporting terminal redevelopment.
Direct multidisciplinary engineering, design and construction teams throughout planning, design and execution.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client representatives and executive stakeholders.
Lead program governance, risk management, scheduling, commercial oversight and quality management.
Coordinate multiple consultants, contractors, specialty disciplines and project partners across a large, integrated program.
Drive collaboration between designers, constructors and client teams to achieve successful project outcomes.
Provide leadership throughout procurement, design development, construction and commissioning activities.
Champion safety, quality, innovation and operational excellence across the program.
Mentor and develop project leadership teams while fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.

What We're Seeking

We're seeking a senior infrastructure leader with a proven record delivering complex capital programs in active aviation environments.

Ideal candidates will possess:

Extensive experience leading major airport infrastructure or terminal redevelopment programs.
Significant experience delivering large-scale Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, P3 or other alternative delivery projects.
Strong understanding of central utility plants, mechanical systems, heating, refrigeration, electrical infrastructure or related building services.
Experience managing large multidisciplinary teams and multiple consulting and construction partners.
Outstanding leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
Demonstrated success managing complex budgets, schedules, risk and program delivery.
Ability to lead within highly regulated, operational airport environments.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architectural Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Professional Engineer (PE) licensure is strongly preferred.
Candidates from Architecture or other relevant technical backgrounds with exceptional aviation program leadership experience will also be considered.
Aviation project experience is considered more valuable than a specific technical discipline.

Why TYLin?

At TYLin, we deliver infrastructure that improves how people move, connect and live.

Joining our Aviation team means becoming part of an internationally respected organization delivering some of the world's most challenging transportation infrastructure projects. You'll work alongside industry-leading professionals while helping shape the future of aviation across North America.

For this role, you'll have the opportunity to:

Lead some of the largest airport infrastructure programs in North America.
Deliver a once-in-a-career, multi-billion-dollar capital investment.
Work with an elite team of industry experts across engineering, architecture and construction.
Influence decisions at the highest levels of project delivery.
Make a lasting impact on critical public infrastructure serving millions of passengers each year.
Relocation assistance is available for outstanding candidates.

Build What's Next

If you're ready to lead infrastructure at a scale few engineers ever experience, we'd love to start the conversation.

Join TYLin and help deliver the next generation of aviation infrastructure for the world's most important transportation networks.

With a 30-year track record of success, SIS functions as an “extension of staff” and is a trusted advisor to its clients. The position requires business management acumen, strong leadership skills, presentation skills, organizational and team building skills, as well as a working knowledge of project controls, quality assurance, risk management, budget management, time management, and client servicing skills. Citi’s mission is to serve as a trusted partner to its clients and communities by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. Citi is a trusted brand with over 200 years of helping to lead the way in the continuously evolving financial services sector. Citi has made it a priority to foster a culture where the best people want to work and where opportunities to develop are widely available to all. We are guided by our leadership standards, a common set of skills and expected behaviours that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

U.S. Consumer Cards offers branded cards, retail private label cards, payment, credit and unsecured lending solutions to consumers and small businesses, with over 100 million customer accounts in North America. With a wide range of proprietary, co-brand and private label cards with leading brands and innovative lending solutions, we have a full spectrum of client-centric payment and lending products and features.

We are focused on evolving with today’s consumer and continue to launch new and innovative card products, evolve our value propositions and reward offerings, extend to new partnerships and provide new digital capabilities to make purchases faster, convenient, and more rewarding.

USCC already has a range of partnerships across a broad spectrum delivering commercial and strategic customer focused outcomes – typically, either to improve product distribution or enhance product capabilities, often with a view towards future industry developments to seize relevant opportunities or protect against emergent risks. These partnerships include over 35 mainstream retailers and e-tailers, hospitality and travel partners; beyond this, Citi has partnerships with large tech industry players, payment providers of various stripes, as well as with specific capability providers; sometimes, these are also in the context of industry coalitions, where Citi often plays a leading role.

To continue this mission, we are seeking to hire the Head of Partner Engagement & Strategy for the Partnership Cards and Development organization (PCD). This critical leadership role will work closely with the Head of PCD and the senior leadership team across USCC to set the vision and strategy for the partnership business, renew existing partnerships and optimize portfolios in alignment with the USCC strategy. This role will also drive the work with key stakeholders to enhance capabilities across cobrand and private label products and working closely with portfolio general managers to prioritize and drive a consistent approach on partner engagement.

This role will lead a team of professionals with direct responsibility to support new partnerships programs to deliver against USCC’s mission and goals, across all the above partner sets. The role will require an in-depth understanding of consumer banking products and services industry and competitive product and service offerings, juxtaposed against Citi’s strengths and capability gaps. A good understanding of the payments industry and digital commerce is vital, as is a grasp of mid-large sized private label and co-brand partnership programs.

The successful candidate for this high impact role requires expertise in negotiation, relationship management, strategic thinking, people leadership, strong financial acumen and an entrepreneurial mindset. Approaching this space with a One-Citi mindset is key. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity beyond USCC. The role will require regular engagement with senior C-suite leaders within and throughout Citi, so communications skills and conviction on deal stance are important attributes.

Responsibilities Include:

Partner with the USCC businesses to identify and implement strategic and tactical initiatives that provide Citi with a sustainable competitive advantage in the marketplace- include supporting potential partnerships, defining partnership constructs and negotiating and executing agreements.
Support or lead transactions from beginning to closing (client sourcing, pitching, M&A process, valuation analyses, due diligence, negotiations, closing)
Evaluate potential transactions and business cases from a strategic, operational, and financial perspective. Lead or assist in client meetings and pitches, providing strategic advice and proposals.
Establish the strategy and direct resources to develop, negotiate and secure manage existing partner contract negotiations.
Integrates Citigroup product offerings as part of a robust financial solutions package as part of the new business and merger/acquisitions activity.
Assist in evaluating the internal and external business environment to develop a long-term overall vision and strategy for the organization.
Oversee key analysis and support for negotiations while working closely with internal and external partners to structure and execute transactions.
Manage internal and external processes for sourcing, evaluating, winning, and closing new partner programs and retention of existing relationships.
Analyze prospects by gathering information about growth, competitors, and market share possibilities.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, keeping as priority the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citi’s clients and assets.
Drives compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervising the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

The key characteristics of the ideal candidate for the position are:

Strategic thinking, financial acumen, and an entrepreneurial mindset.
Excellent stakeholder management skills to ensure alignment and buy-in across the organization.
Superior negotiating proficiency
Continuously challenging the status quo
Strong leadership who leads a high performing organization, focuses on building talent and organizational depth.
Executive communication skills. Ability to synthesize complex and multiple source data into fact based and nuanced solutions.
Ability to build highly credible, influential, and trusting relationships across the firm and with key external partners.
Influential and high track record of followership with demonstrated experience gaining consensus and alignment in a highly matrixed environment.
Ability to set priorities and ‘triage’ in a fast paced, highly matrix, dynamic environment.
Self-motivated, highly adaptive, and able to work well in high stress.
High ethical standards and mature risk tolerance who structures deal with balancing risk and reward.

Requirements:

15+ years of management experience with expertise in financial services
Analytical and conceptual thinker with ability to operate in “white space.”
Demonstrated success in managing internal and external partnerships and ability to negotiate complex structures.
Successful track record of executing deals.
Prior P&L management, strong financial acumen, and analytical skills

Company Description
New York Forwarding Services, Inc. is a global transportation company based in Berkeley Heights, New Jersey, specializing in inland, ocean, and air freight for commercial, government, and military customers. Operating as a Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) and Freight Forwarder, the company provides logistics solutions across major modes of transportation. The COO will manage departmental leaders, set performance goals, and monitor key operational metrics for domestic and international freight activities. To watch our Recruitment video and hear from our team click [here.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w4pMPqgt-sI){rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"}

About The Position

The Community Development Director leads the City of Grand Junction's Community Development Department and serves on the Executive Leadership Team, reporting to the Deputy City Manager. The Director oversees planning and development services, historic preservation, and housing initiatives while helping guide the City's long-term growth and redevelopment.

The ideal candidate is a strong, approachable leader who can clearly communicate complex issues to City Council, residents, developers, and community partners. They will value responsive customer service, consistent application of City codes, and transparent decision-making.

This position requires sound judgment, diplomacy, and the ability to navigate competing priorities in a highly visible environment. The successful candidate will build strong relationships, manage department priorities and resources, and help advance the City's community development goals.

About The Community Development Department

The Community Development Department leads the City's community planning, development services, zoning, historic preservation, and housing functions, and works closely with economic development partners and community organizations to support the City's growth and reinvestment priorities. The department manages current and long-range planning, plan and permit review, annexation, and maintains the City's zoning and development code, and the City's Comprehensive Plan. As a HUD entitlement community, the City receives a direct federal Community Development Block Grant allocation, which the department administers alongside other state and local housing funding.

The department collaborates closely with other City departments, regional and state partners, and community and economic development organizations to advance shared priorities.

What You'll Do

Provide strategic and operational leadership for the City's Community Development Department, including planning and development services, historic preservation, housing, and related community development initiatives.
Lead department priorities, budget development, grant administration, complex development and funding agreements, and continuous improvement of development review and permitting services.
Build and maintain effective relationships with City Council, Planning Commission, community members, developers, economic development partners, and other internal and external stakeholders.
Identify and respond to complex, sensitive, and highly visible community development issues while balancing regulatory requirements, customer service, organizational priorities, and community interests.
Partner with the City Manager, economic development organizations, and other community partners to advance major redevelopment and economic development initiatives throughout the community.
Lead, develop, and support a high-performing team through clear expectations, accountability, collaboration, and professional development.

American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) certification.
Possession of, or ability to obtain, a valid Colorado Driver's license
Possession of, or ability to obtain, the City of Grand Junction Leadership Track certification within two (2) years of appointment.

Other combinations of experience and education that meet the minimum requirements may be substituted.

TYLin
is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

Job Summary

Some opportunities define a career. This is one of them.

TYLin is seeking an exceptional Program Director, Aviation (MEP) to join our Aviation team and play a pivotal leadership role in the delivery of some of the largest and most complex airport capital infrastructure programs currently underway in the US.

Working as part of TYLin's Aviation team, you will serve as one of the senior leaders responsible for delivering a multi-billion-dollar terminal redevelopment program that will modernize critical airport infrastructure for generations to come.

This role is ideal for an experienced infrastructure leader who thrives on solving complex engineering challenges, leading multidisciplinary teams, and delivering major Design-Build or alternative delivery programs in demanding operational environments.

If you're motivated by projects that leave a lasting legacy and want to be at the forefront of transforming one of the busiest aviation hubs in the world - we'd like to hear from you.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

The Opportunity

As Program Director, you will provide executive leadership for the planning, coordination, and delivery of major Mechanical, Electrical and Plant Infrastructure initiatives supporting terminal redevelopment.

A cornerstone of this program is the decommissioning of existing central utility infrastructure and the delivery of new state-of-the-art heating, refrigeration and mechanical plant systems that will support the airport's future operations.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to the client, oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams, coordinate numerous consultant and contractor partners, and ensure successful execution across every phase of the program.

This is a highly visible leadership position with significant responsibility, requiring regular collaboration with executive stakeholders, owners, designers, contractors and construction teams.

Responsibilities

Lead delivery of a major aviation infrastructure program on behalf of the client.
Provide strategic leadership across complex mechanical, electrical and utility infrastructure projects supporting terminal redevelopment.
Direct multidisciplinary engineering, design and construction teams throughout planning, design and execution.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client representatives and executive stakeholders.
Lead program governance, risk management, scheduling, commercial oversight and quality management.
Coordinate multiple consultants, contractors, specialty disciplines and project partners across a large, integrated program.
Drive collaboration between designers, constructors and client teams to achieve successful project outcomes.
Provide leadership throughout procurement, design development, construction and commissioning activities.
Champion safety, quality, innovation and operational excellence across the program.
Mentor and develop project leadership teams while fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.

What We're Seeking

We're seeking a senior infrastructure leader with a proven record delivering complex capital programs in active aviation environments.

Ideal candidates will possess:

Extensive experience leading major airport infrastructure or terminal redevelopment programs.
Significant experience delivering large-scale Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, P3 or other alternative delivery projects.
Strong understanding of central utility plants, mechanical systems, heating, refrigeration, electrical infrastructure or related building services.
Experience managing large multidisciplinary teams and multiple consulting and construction partners.
Outstanding leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
Demonstrated success managing complex budgets, schedules, risk and program delivery.
